clauses.topic: purchase approval authority approver high value threshold procurement
clauses.text: The finance director approves purchases above AED 10,000 before a purchase order is issued.

clauses.topic: supplier onboarding documents registration bank letter vendor
clauses.text: For supplier onboarding, procurement collects a trade licence and a bank confirmation letter.

clauses.topic: competitive quotation quotes sourcing bids three
clauses.text: Procurement collects three written quotations for a competitive sourcing request.

clauses.topic: purchase order retention archive years keep
clauses.text: The purchasing team retains purchase orders for five years in the procurement archive.
Employees submit travel booking requests at least seven calendar days before departure.
Expense reimbursement claims require itemized receipts and must arrive within 30 days of the expense.
An employee's line manager approves annual leave requests in the HR portal.

clauses.topic: remote work equipment return laptop exit
clauses.text: Departing remote employees return company laptops to IT on their last working day.

clauses.topic: duplicate invoice suspected hold accounts payable
clauses.text: Accounts payable places suspected duplicate invoices on hold and contacts the supplier for clarification.

clauses.topic: segregation duties requester approve own self
clauses.text: A requester must never approve their own invoice. A different reviewer records the decision.

clauses.topic: rejection reason audit decision rejected documentation
clauses.text: Reviewers record a written reason for each rejected invoice in the audit history.

clauses.topic: missing evidence supporting document correction review
clauses.text: An invoice with missing supporting evidence stays in manual review until a reviewer documents a correction or override.
